text: どうくつの　なかって　いがいと　ひろいのねー！

structure.jp: どうくつの　なかって
structure.en: the inside of a cave, you know,

structure.jp: いがいと　ひろいのねー！

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a word is a casual way to bring it up as the thing you're talking about, like は. なかって = 'the inside, well...'

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives the feeling of 'so that's how it is'; without だ and followed by ね it sounds feminine. ひろいのねー = 'it's big, isn't it!'
